example.title: Hyatt Regency Long Beach (1983), 200 South Pine Avenue
example.place: Long Beach, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 1983 waterfront hotel: a sixteen-storey slab sheathed in blue-green reflective glass with horizontal banding, set on the harbour edge beside a marina of yachts and a lawn promenade, the convention centre beside it. Three photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
